findings.highlight: Tohsaka, who is staring at me
findings.evidenceJa: 僅かに目を伏せて俺を見つめる遠坂
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka, who watches me with her gaze slightly lowered
findings.explanation: Rin’s restrained, downcast reaction to Shirou’s surrender becomes a plain stare.
Rin’s refusal to blame Shirou becomes merely an absence of raised volume.

findings.highlight: It is sad if I don’t grant it
findings.evidenceJa: 聞き届けてあげなくては可哀相だわ
findings.governingReading: the poor thing would be pitiful if I did not grant his plea
findings.explanation: Caster mockingly pities Shirou; the English makes failure to grant the wish generically “sad.”
Rin’s tactical care is replaced by speed alone.

findings.governingReading: No spoken text in the original Japanese script
findings.explanation: The non-Realta English branch inserts Shirou calling “Tohsaka” where the authoritative Japanese has an active blank utterance and only an inactive voice command.
Pain is removed from Shirou’s desired freezing-darkness image.
The English supplies an external transforming agent where Rin describes the result of Shirou’s choice.

findings.highlight: I try to raise my hand to greet her, but I can’t find my hand.
findings.evidenceJa: 手を挙げる。できなかった
findings.governingReading: I try to raise a hand in greeting, but cannot
findings.explanation: The mature English branch changes inability to move into the concrete horror that Shirou cannot find his hand.

findings.highlight: an embryo in a test tube
findings.evidenceJa: ホルマリン漬けの標本
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces the unspecified preserved specimen with an embryo and changes formaldehyde preservation into a test tube.
The non-Realta branch replaces the recurring impulse to laugh with mental collapse.
